subject: Model-fit & token workplan for ClearCare onboarding
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearcare.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model fit & token workplan for ClearCare onboarding

Hi team,

Handoff from CS: ClearCare is moving into implementation for the pilot (internal deal DW-1742). They want guidance on model shortlist, context length, and a conservative token-volume baseline so we can size Dedicated capacity or set routing policies for hosted. High level:
- Use case: patient triage + summarization for intake forms and chat assist. Mix of deterministic retrieval + generation.
- Security: PHI in prompts; they require SOC2 evidence (we already shared) and VPC option if they go to Private later.
- Timeline: pilot launch in ~6 weeks.

What I have attached: a starter MAP (MVP_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a small sample of anonymized logs from their dev environment (sample_logs.jsonl).

Immediate asks for implementation team (Neha/Rishi):
1) Propose a model shortlist (3 candidates) with reasons (latency/cost/quality trade-offs).
2) Recommend context window and any prefix/KV caching strategies (sessions are patient-scoped).
3) Provide a conservative token-volume estimate (monthly + peak QPS) based on the sample logs.
4) Flag any blocking concerns (auth, residency, long prompt truncation).

Lisa: thanks for the early engagement — included because she can fill in traffic assumptions.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

--

Thanks Monica — got the MAP and logs. Quick clarifying Qs before I build a short deck for the kickoff:

1) For the patient triage flows, are sessions stateful across multiple visits (long-lived) or per-interaction? That changes caching strategy.
2) Are there hard limits on P95 latency for chat (SLO target)?
3) Is there a target cost goal (e.g., < $X / 1k tokens) we should engineer to for the pilot?

Initial thinking (very rough):
- Model shortlist: one cost-focused small model for low-latency (7B-class), one balance model (13B q4_0), one high-quality fallback (70B-style) for long-form summarization.
- Context: sample logs show some long intake transcripts — need to know max context required; I suspect 6k–8k tokens to preserve full intake.
- Token-volume calc: I'll produce a conservative monthly baseline and a 99th-percentile peak to help with Dedicated sizing.

Rishi: can you help with a quick latency/cost sketch on the shortlist? I can draft the recommended runtime config (batching windows, cache TTLs, max sequence lengths) after Lisa confirms the session model.

Neha Kapoor
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Neha/Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below and attached a small anonymized sample (sample_logs.jsonl).

1) Sessions: patient sessions are per-patient and can span multiple interactions. We want the system to be able to reference the last 2–3 interactions in full. Not all patients have long history, but some intake forms are long (filled forms + clinician notes).
2) Latency SLO: For chat assistant, we're aiming for p95 <= 400ms for server-side generation (client can show streaming UI). For summarization jobs we can accept higher latency (2–4s); but prefer to keep summary latency < 2s for pilot.
3) Cost target: Pilot is cost-sensitive, want to keep avg inference spend low — ideally < $0.12 / 1k tokens, but that is flexible if quality requires it.

Traffic (approx, projected from sample + MAU):
- MAU (active users): ~120k/month
- Avg daily QPS: 5 sustained; typical TTL motor: 4–6; peak bursts: up to ~22 QPS for short windows (~10–15 minutes) during business hours.
- Average prompt tokens (after enrichment): ~900 tokens
- Average completion tokens: ~250 tokens
- Typical multi-message session length: 2–3 rounds (so context retention helpful)

Context ask: we believe an 8k token window would cover >95% of flows; a 12k window would cover the extreme clinician notes but increases cost.

Attached: sample_logs.jsonl with 150 anonymized events. Happy to hop on a quick 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Head of Product, ClearCare

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearcare.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model fit & token workplan for ClearCare onboarding

Thanks — good detail from Lisa. I pulled the sample and sketched a recommended shortlist + preliminary sizing below.

PROPOSED MODEL SHORTLIST (pilot order):
1) rw-instruct-13b-q4_0 (quantized 13B) — Balance of latency & quality. Good for chat and summarization with 8k windows when quantized.
2) mistral-instruct-7b (or equivalent 7B opt) — Low latency fallback for interactive chat where p95 matters; lower cost per token but may need retrieval-augmented prompts for accuracy.
3) rw-instruct-70b (or high-capacity variant) — Fallback for hard summarization + clinician notes where hallucination risk must be minimized. Route only for batch summary jobs or when retrieval score low.

RECOMMENDED RUNTIME CONFIG
- Context window: 8k tokens default for chat; enable optional 12k for batch summarization jobs only (configurable per route).
- Caching: prefix/KV caching per patient session with TTL 24 hours; keep most recent 2 interactions cached to reduce repeated re-encoding cost.
- Batching: active batching with max_wait 8–12 ms and max_batch_size tuned per model (13B: batch size 48 ideal on our Dedicated pool; 7B: higher concurrency).
- Fallback policy: primary route -> 13B quantized for most requests; if queueing latency > SLO (p95 > 400ms) fallback to 7B under constrained conditions; heavy summarization jobs routed to 70B on Dedicated with lower concurrency.

TOKEN VOLUME ESTIMATES (conservative)
- Monthly prompt tokens: MAU 120k * avg prompts per user 3 * 900 tokens = ~324M prompt tokens/month
- Monthly completion tokens: MAU 120k * avg completions 3 * 250 tokens = ~90M completion tokens/month
- Total = ~414M tokens/month (round up to 430M to account for overhead and system prompts)
- Sustained QPS estimate: avg 5 QPS; peak short bursts up to 22 QPS (10–15m windows).

SIZING IMPLICATIONS
- Hosted: viable for pilot if we enforce routing and strict batching; expect higher variance in latency.
- Dedicated: recommend a small reserved Dedicated bucket for the 13B quantized instances (to cover peak bursts) plus autoscale policy. We'll provide a sizing calc (GPU counts, vram) in the kickoff deck.

NEXT STEPS
- Neha: I'll hand off a short slide (2 slides) with per-model latency/cost estimates and a table of expected GPU requirement for Dedicated.
- Monica: confirm cost target trade-offs with Lisa (we used $0.12/1k as soft goal).
- Lisa: confirm whether you need encryption-at-rest/KMS for the pilot (we can scope Private later).

I'll attach a brief SOW draft and an updated MAP after the call.

Rishi Malhotra
Applied ML / Inference Optimization, Redwood Inference
